title: North West Frontier Province Sale and Sawing of Timber Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: North West Frontier Province Sale and Sawing of Timber Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XIX OF 1996
ACT XIX OF 1996
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,
1996
1. Short title, extent and commencement.-(1) This Act may be
called the North-West Frontier Province (Sale and Sawing of Timber) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall extend to whole of the North-West Frontier
Province.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: North West Frontier Province Sale and Sawing of Timber Act 1996
sections.description:
Definition

ACT XIX OF 1996
ACT XIX OF 1996
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,
1996
2. Definition.--(1) In this Act, unless the context otherwise
requires,---
(a) "Division" means a Forest Division having
jurisdiction over the area where sale depots or sawing units for timber are
established under this Act;
(b) "Divisional Forest Officer" means the Forest
Officer incharge of the Division concerned;
(c) "Government" means the Government of ,the
North-West Frontier Province;
(d) "prescribed" means prescribed by rules made under
this Act;
(e) "sale depot" means any building or place where
timber is brought and stored for sale; and
(f) "sawing unit" means a saw mill or a saw machine
where timber is cut, sawn or fashioned.
(2) Other expressions used in this Act but not defined shall
have the same meanings as are assigned to them in the Forest Act, 1927 (Act
No.XVI of 1927), or the Hazara Forest Act, 1936 (N.-W.F.P. Act No.VI of 1937),
as the case may be.

sections.shortTitle: North West Frontier Province Sale and Sawing of Timber Act 1996
sections.description:
Restriction on establishment of a sale depot or a sawing unit

ACT XIX OF 1996
ACT XIX OF 1996
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,
1996
3. Restriction on establishment of a sale depot or a sawing
unit.--(1) There shall not be established a sale depot or a sawing unit, unless
the same is registered in such manner and on payment of such fee as may be
prescribed.
(2) A Divisional Forest Officer may, for reasons to be recorded
in writing, refuse to register a sale depot or a sawing unit or cancel the
registration of an existing sale depot or a sawing unit:
Provided that no order under this subsection shall be made
without giving the owner of the sale depot or the sawing unit, as the case may
be, an opportunity of being heard.
(3) Where registration of a sale depot or a sawing unit is
cancelled under subsection (2), or it has expired, the sale depot or the sawing
unit, as the case may be, shall cease to function or operate, except in the
case of expiry of registration, if the owner of the sale depot or the sawing
unit, as the case may be, has, in the prescribed manner, applied for renewal of
the registration and his request for renewal has not been refused:
Provided that no request for renewal shall be refused without
apprising the owner of the sale depot or the sawing unit concerned of the
reasons for refusal and without giving him an opportunity of being heard.

sections.shortTitle: North West Frontier Province Sale and Sawing of Timber Act 1996
sections.description:
Maintenance of record

ACT XIX OF 1996
ACT XIX OF 1996
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,
1996
4. Maintenance of record.--(1) Every owner of a sale depot or a
sawing unit shall maintain such record or keep such register as may be
prescribed.
(2) The record or register being maintained under subsection
(1) shall be open to inspection by such officers as may be authorised by
Government.

Appeal

Act or the rules made thereunder shall have such right of appeal as may be

sections.shortTitle: North West Frontier Province Sale and Sawing of Timber Act 1996
sections.description:
Offences and penalties

ACT XIX OF 1996
ACT XIX OF 1996
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,
1996
6. Offences and penalties.--(1) Contravention of any of the
provisions of this Act or the rules made thereunder shall constitute an offence
rendering the offender liable to imprisonment for a term which shall not be
less than three months and may extend to two years, or to fine which shall not
be less than one thousand rupees and may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with
both, and may further entail seizure and confiscation of illicit timber as well
as seizure, dismantling, sealing and confiscation of the apparatus or machinery
used in the contravention:
Provided that where the offence is committed after the sunset
and before the sunrise or when the offender causes hindrance in the performance
of lawful duties under this Act or has been previously convicted of a like
offence, he may be inflicted with double the penalties specified above.
(2) Any Forest or Police Officer may arrest, without warrant,
any person committing within his sight an offence punishable under this Act.
(3) Every officer making an arrest under this section shall,
without unnecessary delay, take or send the person so arrested to the nearest
Magistrate or Police Station.

sections.shortTitle: North West Frontier Province Sale and Sawing of Timber Act 1996

Cognizance of offences

ACT XIX OF 1996

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,

7. Cognizance of offences.--No Court shall take cognizance of
any offence punishable under this Act or the rules made thereunder, except on a
report in writing of the facts constituting such offence made by a Forest
Officer or a Police Officer.

sections.description:
Indemnity

ACT XIX OF 1996
ACT XIX OF 1996
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,

8. Indemnity.--No suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding
shall lie against any person for anything done or intended to be done in good
faith in pursuance of any provision of this Act or the rules made thereunder.

sections.shortTitle: North West Frontier Province Sale and Sawing of Timber Act 1996
sections.description:
Application of certain provisions of the Forest Act, 1927 and the Hazara Forest Act, 1936

ACT XIX OF 1996
ACT XIX OF 1996
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,
1996
9. Application of certain provisions of the Forest Act, 1927
and the Hazara Forest Act, 1936.--The provisions of Chapter IX of the Forest
Act, 1927, with the exception of section 62, and Chapter VII of the Hazara
Forest Act, 1936, with the exception of sections 34 to 38 and section 47, shall
apply, so far as may be, to any infringement of the rules made under this Act
as if such infringement were a forest offence under the respective Acts.

sections.shortTitle: North West Frontier Province Sale and Sawing of Timber Act 1996
sections.description:
Power to make rules

ACT XIX OF 1996
ACT XIX OF 1996
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,
1996
10. Power to make rules.--(1) Government may make rules to
carry out the purposes of this Act.
(2) Without prejudice to the generality of the foregoing
provisions such rules may provide for all or any of the following matters,
namely--
(a) the classes of Timber to which the rules shall apply;
(b) establishment, registration, regulation and inspection of
sale depots and sawing units;
(c) fee for registration, including the renewal fee and the
period for which the registration shall hold good;
(d) conditions under which timber may be brought to, stored at,
and removed from, sale depots, or cut, sawn or fashioned at a sawing unit;
(e) specification of Timber, the sale, cutting; sawing or
fashioning whereof is prohibited;
(t) form of registers to be maintained at the sale depots and
sawing units;
(g) security to be pledged with the Divisional Forest Officer
for the establishment of sale depots and sawing units; and
(h) seizure and sealing of unregistered sale depots and sawing
units, including dismantling thereof and confiscation of timber and appliances
found therein.

sections.shortTitle: North West Frontier Province Sale and Sawing of Timber Act 1996
sections.description:
Repeal and saving

ACT XIX OF 1996
ACT XIX OF 1996
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,
1996
11. Repeal and saving.--(1) The Punjab Forest (Sale of Timber)
Act, 1913, in its application to the North-West Frontier Province (Sale and
Sawing of Timber) Ordinance, .,1996 (N,-W.F.P. Ordinance No.V of 1996) are
hereby repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding the repeal of the Act mentioned in
subsection (1), everything done, action taken, obligation, liability, penalty
or punishment incurred, inquiry or proceeding commenced, officers appointed or
person authorised, jurisdiction or power conferred, rule made and order or
notification issued under any of the provisions of the said Act, shall, if not
inconsistent with the provisions of this Act, be continued, and so far as may
be, be deemed to have been respectively done, taken, incurred, commenced,
appointed, authorised, conferred, made or issue under this Act.
